text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Shinko Windy and I head into<n>town, we come
across some<n>Umamusume gearing up to perform a
mini concert.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! I've been waiting for this!<n>You're so cute
today! Look over<n>here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! No fair! Why are they hoggin' all<n>the attention
when I'm here too?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I won't stand for this. I've gotta<n>come up with a
plan...
Hmmm, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn toward the source of the voice<n>and find Smart
Falcon, looking<n>puzzled.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, one of the members who's<n>supposed to
perform in this concert<n>got stuck in traffic and is
gonna be<n>late!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I promised them I'd make this collab<n>between us a
grand success...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I can't cancel the performance!<n>There has to be
something I can do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This concert seems really important to<n>her. I'd like
to help, but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I knew they had one. I'mma use<n>this machine
to blow smoke<n>everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And then I'll make my appearance<n>from within the
chaos! Hehehe,<n>everyone's gonna be staring right
at<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Concert Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, an Umamusume?! So you made it!<n>Thank
goodness! Let's get you into<n>costume quick!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Uh, r-right.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Did they mistake me for someone<n>else? Well,
whatever—this suits my<n>plan just fine!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fssshhh!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why's there so much smoke?!<n>Look!
Someone's up on stage!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha! Bet I scared ya, huh! Get<n>ready, 'cause
this prank's just<n>gettin' started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm running around in a fluster<n>trying to find
where Shinko Windy<n>went, she appears on stage
amidst a<n>billow of smoke!
choice_data_list: Windy?! Is this another one of her pranks?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, could this be the break I was<n>hoping for?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Appearing on stage is the<n>Umamusume who'll take
a bite out of<n>your heart! ♪ It's Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Our scheduled performer is running a<n>little late, so
Windy's here to entertain<n>you all in the meantime!
Give her a<n>great big cheer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uhh... Cheer?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
A substitute performer! Well, the way<n>she popped
out of that smoke shows<n>she's full of energy. Do
your best!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why are you all smiling?! You're<n>supposed to
be cowering in fear!
choice_data_list: I'm proud of you for helping out!
I'm proud of you for helping out!
Put on a heck of a show!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why are you all smiling?! You're<n>supposed to
be cowering in fear!
choice_data_list: I'm proud of you for helping out!
I'm proud of you for helping out!
Put on a heck of a show!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya even mean?! My big,<n>amazing prank was
supposed to<n>make you all scared!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're extra cute when you try<n>to hide your
embarrassment. ☆ But<n>you're such an open book,
Windy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm telling ya, you've got it all<n>twisted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd thoroughly enjoys what<n>they believe is
Shinko Windy's<n>comedy bit, and the concert is a
great<n>success.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A-a heck of a... show?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see you perform,<n>Windy!
Everyone's watching! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're right... Heh, heheh... ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, if you're that desperate to<n>see me in action,
I guess I can't say<n>no! You better be grateful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy dances around stage,<n>making a
racket, and the concert is a<n>great success.
